body:
internal/mailaccounts/client.go: a real JMAP client replaying Stalwart's own login flow (POST /api/auth -> POST /auth/token) since its OAuth server has no client_credentials grant. Calls the real x:Account/set (create) and x:Account/query+get (list) methods, captured live via Playwright network capture. GET/POST /api/v1/mail-accounts, gated on users.admin. Two real bugs found via live testing: a too-short PKCE code_verifier (Stalwart rejected with bare invalid_grant, RFC 7636 requires 43+ chars -- explains earlier session invalid_grant failures too), and a credential-over-unverified-TLS gap fixed with https:// + scoped InsecureSkipVerify (mail.carepyre.org's cert is still self-signed). Live-verified against the real running instance (list + create + delete a real test mailbox). CarePyre console.html got a matching admin-only 'Mail accounts' panel. Commits: IDUNA_PRO 378321e, CarePyre 5ac6fa3.

⚓ ☃
title: Real Stalwart mailbox provisioning added to the CarePyre admin console
